value.rationale: The marked minimum-enclosing radius distinguishes pair versus triple supports in a natural randomized enclosing-disk problem. Its logarithmic three-site suppression is a sharp structural boundary-layer phenomenon not encoded by the known pair-length marginal, giving an interpretable rare-event conditional law and exact constants relevant to random small-neighborhood statistics.
